   4444 /**

   4446  *
   4447  * Used as the type of `env.AI_SEARCH` (namespace binding via `ai_search_namespaces`).

   4450  *
   4451  * @example
   4452  * ```ts
   4453  * // Access an instance within the namespace
   4454  * const blog = env.AI_SEARCH.get("blog");
   4455  * const results = await blog.search({ query: "How does caching work?" });
   4456  *
   4457  * // List all instances in the namespace
   4458  * const instances = await env.AI_SEARCH.list();
   4459  *
   4460  * // Create a new instance with built-in storage
   4461  * const tenant = await env.AI_SEARCH.create({ id: "tenant-123" });
   4462  *
   4463  * // Upload items into the instance
   4464  * await tenant.items.upload("doc.pdf", fileContent);
   4465  *
   4466  * // Search across multiple instances
   4467  * const multi = await env.AI_SEARCH.search({
   4468  *   query: "caching",
   4469  *   ai_search_options: { instance_ids: ["blog", "docs"] },
   4470  * });
   4471  *
   4472  * // Delete an instance
   4473  * await env.AI_SEARCH.delete("tenant-123");
   4474  * ```
   4475  */

   4486      * @returns Array of instance metadata with pagination info.
   4487      */
   4488     list(params?: AiSearchListInstancesParams): Promise<AiSearchListResponse>;
   4489     /**
   4490      * Create a new instance within the bound namespace.
   4491      * @param config Instance configuration. Only `id` is required — omit `type` and `source` to create with built-in storage.
   4492      * @returns Instance service for the newly created instance.
   4493      *
   4494      * @example
   4495      * ```ts
   4496      * // Create with built-in storage (upload items manually)
   4497      * const instance = await env.AI_SEARCH.create({ id: "my-search" });
   4498      *
   4499      * // Create with web crawler source
   4500      * const instance = await env.AI_SEARCH.create({
   4501      *   id: "docs-search",
   4502      *   type: "web-crawler",
   4503      *   source: "https://developers.cloudflare.com",
   4504      * });
   4505      * ```
   4506      */
   4507     create(config: AiSearchConfig): Promise<AiSearchInstance>;
   4508     /**
   4509      * Delete an instance from the bound namespace.
   4510      * @param name Instance name to delete.
   4511      */
   4512     delete(name: string): Promise<void>;
   4513     /**
   4514      * Search across multiple instances within the bound namespace.
   4515      * Fans out to the specified instance_ids and merges results.

  11342      * from the top. {fit: "cover", gravity: {x:0.5, y:0.2}} will crop each side to
